description: Block pallet (EUR style): bottom boards, a 3 × 3 grid of blocks, cross boards and a top deck. Pivot at the centre of the base; deck boards run along X. Pieces: pallet_boards (wood_light), pallet_blocks (wood). Every piece is a closed box.

width.desc: size along X (m), the deck board direction

block_height.desc: height of the blocks between the board layers (m)

seed.desc: random seed of the board tint

board_pts.note: bottom boards (3, along X), cross boards (3, along Z) on the blocks, deck boards (along X)

paint.note: Cd = the material's base colour (times the optional point attribute tint)

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
